name: Msedge
tagline: A cross-platform web browser developed by Microsoft and based on Chromium.
description: Microsoft Edge is a cross-platform web browser developed by Microsoft and based on Chromium.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/msedge:155.0.4283@sha256:4e93ca32e16e3746347277fe2e39c7d8e11faab66e84cec5a777d9a63c7e80b1
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      EDGE_CLI: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
